description: Searches the hosted paprika3d asset library over the network (assets.keeno.dev) for a ready-made model (57k, CC BY or CC0, as GLB and some as USD), PBR texture or HDRI sky, and puts the one you pick in the project with its loading code. A search answers one numbered line per hit (id, name, size, licence, preview image) and a contact sheet: the hits' thumbnails in one row, numbered as the lines are. `pick` an id from it (or its start, when no other hit shown in this project starts so) to download the file into assets/ (public/assets/ with vite) and get the code that loads it, a model at real size (or `height` units tall) and credited in CREDITS.md. `not` lists ids that missed, which the library learns from, and searches again without them; `more` searches the same query again for the next hits. `image` (a picture in the project, with `crop` to cut one thing out of it) ranks models by how alike they look, for the thing a reference picture shows that words miss. The library logs model searches, picks and rejections with the agent's name.

crop.description: With image: [left, top, right, bottom] in the picture's pixels, as `reference` reads them: the one thing to find, cut out of the scene.

format.description: Models only. In a search, only models with a file of this format; with pick, the file to download: a model with both is saved as its GLB unless this is usd, and one with only a USD file (.usdz) as that, loaded with three's USDLoader (r183 or later).

height.description: With pick: scale a model to this many units tall.

image.description: Models only: a picture under cwd (refs/01.jpg) or a look baseline's name, to rank models by how alike they look to it (with query, by both); the reply shows the image searched with.

model.description: Optional: your own model name, e.g. "claude-opus-5-5", sent with model searches and picks only, so the library can learn which agents its picks suit; nothing else about the session.

more.description: With the same query: the next hits, past every one it has shown, none of them rejected.

not.description: Ids from the last search to reject.

pick.description: An id to download, or the start of one that no other hit shown in this project (in any session) starts with.

query.description: What you need, e.g. "wooden barrel", "mossy cobblestone", "sunset sky".

save.description: Also save the contact sheet to this .jpg under cwd.

sheet.description: false leaves out the contact sheet, the picture of the shown hits' thumbnails in one row, numbered as the lines are (on by default).

textures.description: With pick: false saves a model's geometry only, every texture dropped (for a model you colour or texture yourself).

name: asset_search
